card.name: False-positive urine drug screen wording
card.fires_on: Small words such as "for" or "the" right before a drug name (amphetamines, PCP) in statements about false-positive urine drug tests. Also the word "drug" in "drug-of-abuse test".

modes.label: Linking word before screened drug
modes.description: "for" or "the" after urine test wording, just before the drug that is screened for.
